episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the evolving luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of lifestyle optimization and the impact of AI on buyer behavior. She shares insights on building strong relationships and personal branding to stand out in a competitive market. Additionally, Carrie provides tactical advice on handling multiple offers and enhancing digital presence.
